title: fix(plugin-sharing): a record share's Recipient column names the recipient through the recipient-picker face
body:
Fixes #24701

Clause-②: no

Half (b) of the card: the record share's Recipient column draws the recipient's raw id. Half (a) landed earlier as PR #24733 ("Part of"). This PR does what the seat's ruling `6282390889` ordered (route B, a display declaration only).

## What changes

`sys_record_share.recipient_id` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/objects/sys-record-share.object.ts`) now declares:

```ts
widget: 'recipient-picker',
dependsOn: ['recipient_type'],
```

This is the display declaration `sys_sharing_rule.recipient_id` already carries, without `object_name` (see M1 below). No stored column, spec key, accepted value, list-view column or objectui file changes. The field stays a required `text` column with `maxLength: 100`. The object stays `engine-owned` with `enable.apiMethods: ['get', 'list']`.

The other changed files are a new pin, `src/objects/sys-record-share.recipient-face.test.ts` (7 cases), and a patch changeset, `.changeset/24701-record-share-recipient-face.md`.

## Ruling premises, re-checked before the edit

Re-checked on `origin/main` `a43405d59` (the branch point) and at the console pin `.objectui-sha` = `12dc7b47c340`, which is unchanged on main at `307ce4c4b`. The objectui source was read with `git show` and `git grep` at that sha. No browser reading was taken.

- **P1 holds.** `all_shares` is the only view whose columns include `recipient_type`. `granted_by_me`, `by_object`, `manual_grants` and `rule_grants` show `recipient_id` without it. `granted_to_me` shows neither.
- **P2 holds.** At the pin, `ObjectGrid.tsx` builds `extraFields` from predicate, grouping, concurrency, row-colour, deadline and `referenceVia` fields only. There is no `dependsOn` arm in that projection. `ListView.tsx` has no `dependsOn` hit at all.
- **P3 holds.** The type-only cell renderer passes the whole row as `dependentValues` (`ObjectGrid.tsx`, objectui#12613). `useRecipientLabel` (`refLabelDirectory.ts`) builds an empty key when the row has no `recipient_type`, so the entry stays `unasked`. `RecipientCellFace` then falls through to `TextCellRenderer`, the stored text, as today.

So at the pin, `all_shares` names the user, and the other four views and the H1 draw what they draw today. The seat files the two console rules (project a faced column's `dependsOn` siblings; draw a widget-hinted `nameField` through its face) after this lands.

## The PM's mechanism assumptions, measured

- **M1: `['recipient_type']` is enough.** At the pin, `useRecipientLabel` reads `object_name` only when the kind is `field` (`FIELD_RECIPIENT_TYPE`). `sys_record_share.recipient_type` offers `user`, `group`, `position` and `unit_and_subordinates`, and has no `field` kind. The kinds map as follows: `user` and `unit_and_subordinates` are exact-id record kinds (`RECIPIENT_RECORD_KINDS`), `position` is a registry kind, and `group` is in neither table, so it draws as text. `grant()` writes only `user` (ADR-0111 D7). `object_name` was therefore not added. A pin derives `dependsOn` from the select's kinds, and its control derives the sibling's `['recipient_type', 'object_name']` from that object's `field` kind.
- **M2: no write or edit path changes.** In this repository, `field.widget` is read by the spec schema and the liveness ledger only, and no runtime code reads it. The server-side `dependsOn` readers are the lint reference check (`validate-object-field-refs.ts`, which judges that a named sibling exists) and the FLS reference masking. Neither is a write path. The object is `engine-owned` with `apiMethods: ['get', 'list']` and no `userActions`. At the pin, the docblocks of the console's write gates (`plugin-form/src/fieldWriteGate.ts`, `plugin-grid/src/rowCrudAffordances.ts`) say engine-owned objects resolve closed unless they open `userActions`, so no form draws the picker as an editor. Fork case 2 does not apply.
- **Fork case 1 does not apply either.** No gate refuses a `recipient-picker` whose `dependsOn` names only `recipient_type`. `validateObjectFieldRefs` over the package's three objects at the branch head gave 0 findings. Its control, with `dependsOn: ['recipient_kind']`, gave 1 finding: `fields.recipient_id.dependsOn[0] "recipient_kind" is not a field on object "sys_record_share"`.
- **M3: which gates read the declaration.** See the gate list below. No derived family is specific to field `widget` or `dependsOn`. The ones that read the changed object file are the general census and source families.

## Pins

`src/objects/sys-record-share.recipient-face.test.ts`:

1. The declaration, read off the object, is `recipient-picker`, the same value as `sys_sharing_rule.recipient_id`.
2. `dependsOn` names exactly the siblings the face reads for the kinds this object's select stores, and each one is a declared field.
3. Control: the same rule yields the sibling's `['recipient_type', 'object_name']`, because that object stores the `field` kind.
4. Negative: the declaration opens no write path. The stored column is unchanged (`text`, required, `maxLength: 100`, no `reference` or `referenceVia`), the object is `engine-owned`, `apiMethods` stays `['get', 'list']`, and there are no `userActions`.
5. Control: the insert census over this package's non-test `src/` reads the other inserts (`sys_share_link`, `sys_sharing_rule`), so it is never empty.
6. Negative: every `insert` call in the package names its table in a form the census reads: a string literal, or an identifier bound to a same-file string constant.
7. Negative: the only insert of a `sys_record_share` row is `grant()` in `sharing-service.ts`. The census is a TypeScript-AST walk scoped to this package's sources, not a whole-tree scan. The one writer measured outside the package, the CLI's organization-ownership apply, updates `source_id` and inserts nothing.

The existing `sharing-pointer-pairs.test.ts`, `sys-sharing-rule.by-object.test.ts` and `field-recipient.test.ts` pins stay green.

### Ablations

Each leg ran on the committed fix through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode. Each anchor hit exactly once and the blob changed. A shell trap restored the files from `HEAD`. The pin imports the object and reads `sharing-service.ts` by source path, so no `dist/` sits between a mutation and the run, and no rebuild was needed.

| Leg | Mutation | Red case(s) | Received |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| F | delete the two declaration lines (blob `ecfd40c1d865` to `82c721526026`) | 1, 2 | `expected undefined to be 'recipient-picker'`; `expected undefined to deeply equal [ 'recipient_type' ]` |
| N1 | `apiMethods: ['get', 'list', 'update']` | 4 | `expected [ 'get', 'list', 'update' ] to deeply equal [ 'get', 'list' ]` |
| N2 | add `this.engine.insert('sys_record_share', …)` in `revoke()` | 7 | `+ "sharing-service.ts#revoke"` |
| N2b | add `this.engine.insert(tableFromElsewhere(), …)` in `revoke()` | 6 | `+ "sharing-service.ts#revoke: (unresolved: tableFromElsewhere())"` |

Every other case stayed green in each leg (`Tests 2 failed / 5 passed`, then `1 failed / 6 passed` three times). Restore was checked per file: `sys-record-share.object.ts` blob `ecfd40c1d865` and `sharing-service.ts` blob `52704b19f94e` both equal `HEAD`, and `git diff HEAD` is empty on both.

## Verification

All on head `1dc0ab1bf` (the branch merged with `origin/main` `307ce4c4b` before opening), each under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, with the exit code captured before any pipe:

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/plugin-sharing...' build`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing test`: exit 0, `Test Files 52 passed (52)`, `Tests 1199 passed (1199)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing typecheck`: exit 0. `check:test-typecheck` reports the ledger unchanged (2 files, 3 errors, 3 signatures). `tsc --listFiles -p tsconfig.test.json` lists the new pin, and the only errors are the 3 ledgered ones.

Gates on head `1dc0ab1bf`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`, with no paths, derived 68 commands over the 3 changed files. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe.

- 66 exited 0 on the first pass.
- `pnpm check:i18n` first exited 3 (prerequisite: no CLI build). Its prescribed `turbo run build` closure gave VERDICT command-exit 0 (61 tasks). The rerun exited 0: `check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) — all bundles in sync, no undeclared authoring keys)`.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET: it needs a whole-workspace build (57 packages without `dist/`). NOT MEASURED, a declared narrowing. The diff changes no entry point, export or build config, and CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` runs it.
- `--ran`: `Run reconciliation — 68 derived, 67 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`, exit 0.

Declared to CI and not run locally: `test:repo`, `pnpm lint`, the type-check lanes, `Build Core` and the `Test Core` shards. `check:dev-prereqs` and `check:skill-frame-freshness` were not run, because the diff touches neither the spec build nor the frame files. `check-platform-checklist` was not run, because no exported symbol is renamed or deleted.

## Acceptance notes

- **The H1 and four list views are unchanged at this pin** (P2, P3). They follow the two console rules the ruling assigns to objectui, which the seat files after this lands. ⛔ No column was added to a view to feed the face, and no objectui file is edited.
- **The `widget` liveness note is now incomplete.** `packages/spec/liveness/field.json` says `widget` is "live on the sys_sharing_rule trio alone". `sys_record_share.recipient_id` now declares one too, so the note under-counts. The verdict (`live`) is unchanged. It is not edited here, because this claim excludes `packages/spec/**`. Carrier: none.
- **The HotCRM pass (`6283814156`) ran on 18.0.0-next.5**, published 2026-10-19T11:06Z. That is before `54159fd74` (#24611's fix, 2026-10-20T00:58Z), which took `record_id` out of `highlightFields` so the Details tab draws it as the pointer card. Its "Record shows a raw id on the record overlay" reading is therefore not a reading of current `main`. It is NOT MEASURED here (no browser reading). Its "no column names the granting rule" reading is a product question, not a defect class: `rule_grants` shows `source_id`, and `all_shares` does not. Neither item is edited.
- `sys_record_share.recipient_type` still offers `group`, `position` and `unit_and_subordinates`, which no writer produces. That is ruling C's protocol question, which the seat kept off this card. Not touched.
